book: Ottonis Casmanni Anti-Socinus, Tractatus ad diiudicandam controversiam theologicam (Amberg 1612): a Latin polemical treatise in two parts (Pars I on the faith and the merit and satisfaction of Christ, Pars II refuting the Socinian objections), preceded by dedicatory, preface and reader matter, each part divided into capita and sectiones.
